units.text: Yes, you can reschedule or withdraw your Board hearing request.
supporting_chunk_ids: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0009
units.reason: The context states you can write to the Board to withdraw your hearing request, and provides rescheduling instructions.

units.text: To reschedule, you must send a written request to the Board of Veterans Appeals at least 2 weeks before your hearing, explaining the reason and including your name and VA file number.
supporting_chunk_ids: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0008
units.reason: The context explicitly states you need to send a written request at least 2 weeks before, with reason, name, and VA file number.

units.text: If your hearing is less than 2 weeks away, you must file a motion explaining why.
supporting_chunk_ids: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0008
units.reason: The context states if the hearing is less than 2 weeks away, you need to file a motion explaining the reason.

units.text: To withdraw, you or your representative should send a written request at least 2 weeks before the hearing, including your name, VA file number, and reason.
supporting_chunk_ids: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0009
units.reason: The context states you or your representative should send a written request at least 2 weeks before, including name, VA file number, and reason.

units.text: Withdrawing won't speed up your appeal unless you switch to the Direct Review option.
supporting_chunk_ids: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0009
units.reason: The context states withdrawing won't speed up your appeal unless you switch to the Direct Review option.

units.text: You can still submit new evidence within 90 days after withdrawing your hearing request.
supporting_chunk_ids: Board hearings with a Veterans Law Judge | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0009
units.reason: The context states you can still submit new evidence within 90 days after withdrawing your hearing request.
